reviewedPredicates.Q25: Does the examined control-plane actions material contain a record of the observed named cloud resource state matching every declared subject and the bound interval? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q90: Do separately originating validated records of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the artifact provenance evidence focus, agree on the explicitly declared discriminator within its assessed namespace or mapping and exact subject/time bounds? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q97: Does the selected record of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the endpoint state changes evidence focus, have a cited acceptable provenance and interpretation basis? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q146: Do separately originating validated records of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the artifact provenance evidence focus, agree on the explicitly declared discriminator within its assessed namespace or mapping and exact subject/time bounds? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q195: Does the validated record of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the control-plane actions evidence focus, satisfy the declared criterion for one named technical hypothesis, with competing explanations assessed? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q357: Do separately validated records of the observed named cloud resource state and the named target, examined under the endpoint state changes evidence focus, meet the declared temporal-coincidence tolerance within their own bounded contexts after accounting for both clock uncertainties? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q386: Does the assessed discriminator for the observed named cloud resource state in the examined control-plane actions material support the named technical source under its declared criterion, with competing explanations retained? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
reviewedPredicates.Q434: Does the assessed discriminator for the observed named cloud resource state in the examined endpoint state changes material support the named technical source under its declared criterion, with competing explanations retained? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.

definitions.Q25: Does the examined control-plane actions material contain a record of the observed named cloud resource state matching every declared subject and the bound interval? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q90: Do separately originating validated records of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the artifact provenance evidence focus, agree on the explicitly declared discriminator within its assessed namespace or mapping and exact subject/time bounds? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q97: Does the selected record of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the endpoint state changes evidence focus, have a cited acceptable provenance and interpretation basis? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q146: Do separately originating validated records of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the artifact provenance evidence focus, agree on the explicitly declared discriminator within its assessed namespace or mapping and exact subject/time bounds? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q195: Does the validated record of the observed named cloud resource state, examined under the control-plane actions evidence focus, satisfy the declared criterion for one named technical hypothesis, with competing explanations assessed? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q357: Do separately validated records of the observed named cloud resource state and the named target, examined under the endpoint state changes evidence focus, meet the declared temporal-coincidence tolerance within their own bounded contexts after accounting for both clock uncertainties? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q386: Does the assessed discriminator for the observed named cloud resource state in the examined control-plane actions material support the named technical source under its declared criterion, with competing explanations retained? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
definitions.Q434: Does the assessed discriminator for the observed named cloud resource state in the examined endpoint state changes material support the named technical source under its declared criterion, with competing explanations retained? This profile assesses an observation; the evidence-focus label alone does not establish a historical change, action, execution or access.
